lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters arranged in vertical columns posterior to the branchial region, showing a transition from dense grouping to a wider 2D spatial distribution towards the posterior.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting horizontal rows of spots, forming a rectangular grid of nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges visible along the upper flank, displaying a high-contrast gradient with dorsal illumination and ventral shadowing.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high spatial density of small high-luminance pixels compared to the more sparse distribution on the lateral flank.
